memory.description: Fresh evidence on every run; disable memory and cross-thread sharing after import.

safetyControls: Read-only application access; no posting, approvals, payments, enrollment, messages, job restart or cancellation.
Historical dates, organization, currency, units and row grain stay visible; empty and failed queries must be disclosed.
The shared integration reader does not reproduce per-person application authorization.
setup: Import the generated .paf with the repository passphrase; keep it unpublished while reviewing.
Rebind each database node to JDE Replica Manufacturing Read Only. Bind to the GoldenGate target JDEDEMO PDB, not the original JDEORCL source. Keep the source connections and published flows separate.
Select the model on every Agent node; model connections are excluded from the archive.
Disable Agent Memory and sharing between chat threads for this flow; those switches are not bundled in the official export.
Run the primary prompt, inspect the actual evidence, and use the limitations follow-up.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Choose the first candidate work order with component rows in the replica and review up to five component risks. Identify the order and explain the inventory, unit and requirement-grain checks a planner must make before confirming readiness.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Explain what this bounded replica evidence cannot prove and what a human owner should verify before acting.

expectedOutcomes: A bounded evidence-backed explanation and a concrete next step for a human owner.
A clear distinction between the observed sample and claims it cannot establish.
